BiblicalUsage: Hupham is a son of Benjamin, named in the census in the wilderness as the head of the family of the Huphamites. His name appears once, in the count of Israel's fighting men. The family that carries his name is counted among the tribes.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hupham is remembered because the census counts every family, and no household is too small for God's numbering.
